newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK PIRAEUS BANK H1 PROFIT JUMPS 122PCT.
newsitem.headline: GREEK PIRAEUS BANK H1 PROFIT JUMPS 122PCT.

text.p: Piraeus Bank said in a statement its first half pre-tax profit rose 122.1 percent year-on-year to 3.117 billion drachmas from 1.403 billion in the same period a year earlier.
As of end-June, Piraeus bank's total assets amounted to 233.9 billion drachmas, up from year-earlier 162.9 billion, it said.
In July 1997, the bank had issued an earnings growth forecast of around 56 percent this year, exceeding 5.0 billion drachmas versus 3.2 billion in 1996.
According to the same forecast, consolidated profit was seen exceeding 8.0 billion drachmas against 5.3 billion in 1996.
The bank did not issue a revision of these full-year forecasts following the announcement of its six-month results. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
